trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) < 1 AND CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) = 24 RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE regexp_matches(p.draft_pick, '^24') AND (p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' OR p.olympic_gold_medals = '0.0') RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE regexp_matches(lower(p.draft_pick), '.*24.*') AND (regexp_matches(lower(p.olympic_gold_medals), '.*0.*') OR lower(p.olympic_gold_medals) = 'none' OR lower(p.olympic_gold_medals) = 'no') RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CONTAINS(lower(p.draft_pick), '24') AND (CONTAINS(lower(p.olympic_gold_medals), '0') OR lower(p.olympic_gold_medals) IN ['none', 'no', 'zero']) RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player
